title: Chapter 903
text:
In space, the force field could continuously increase the acceleration of an object. This was the most suitable battlefield for Ames. Her force field Esper Ability was originally focused on defense and control, but in Ames' hands, it was extremely powerful.

Under the effect of the force field, Floating Dragon's speed continued to increase. Its huge size was equivalent to an extremely large area of effect. If Floating Dragon was allowed to increase its speed without limit, it would become more and more difficult to dodge.

However, Floating Dragon was still not fast enough. In Han Xiao 'eyes, it was as slow as a tortoise. He had more than ten ways to dodge Floating Dragon's attack this time. Just the high mobility of his mechanical suit would allow him to go around Floating Dragon before it hit him.

However, Ames did not just use the brick to hit people. Her eyes shone, and she released a force field that imprisoned Han Xiao 'body and dragged him toward Floating Dragon.

Force Field — Gaze of the Dragon!

The force field around him seemed to have solidified, and Han Xiao was under immense pressure all over his body. Every movement of his was greatly hindered, and at the same time, he was dragged forward by a suction force.

"I've used this move before …" Han Xiao's mouth twitched.

With his current ability, he was not afraid of Ames' control ability, and he could easily tear apart the force field that imprisoned him. However, he did not plan to dodge this Floating Dragon's attack. He purposely wanted to test its power and obtain battle information. At the same time, he also wanted to test the effect of the upgraded ability.

Floating Dragon was getting closer and closer, and he could already see the scenery of Floating Dragon's surface.

A huge pressure hit him head-on, and he felt the word 'danger' appear above his head.

Han Xiao calmed himself down and raised his arms. Nanoparticles flowed on the surface of his mechanical suit and gathered on his arms, turning into shield generators. With a flash of blue light, layers of psionic shields appeared in front of Han Xiao, forming a defense.

The next moment, Floating Dragon Island charged over, and the huge inertia slapped Han Xiao onto the shield of Floating Dragon Island, pushing him further and further away.

Ames turned her palm, and Floating Dragon drew an arc in the air and fell toward the gas giant planet beside them, preparing to smash Han Xiao into the planet.

At the same time, Psionic Prime led the Mech Legion close to Ames and fired psionic particle cannon shots at Ames.

Ames' ten Satellite Bricks were not idle either. Six of them were placed in different directions and circled around Ames. They were covered with an energy shield and a defensive force field, forming a defensive line that blocked most of the psionic cannons.

The gaps in the defensive line were filled up by the defensive force field, and the psionic particle cannon shots were all turned into fragments.

The other four Satellite Grade Bricks charged at the Mech Legion formation under the control of Ames' force field.

The Mech Legion was not as gentle toward the satellites. The psionic particle cannon shots were fired continuously, blasting holes in the Satellite Grade Bricks, and metal fragments floated everywhere. These fragments then turned into a metal storm under the control of Ames, passing through the Mech Legion and leaving scratches on the surface of the mechanical soldiers.

The Apostle Weapons ignored these attacks and quickly closed in on Ames' defensive line. Psionic Prime swung his spear and slashed out an energy wave, which hit the defensive force field and caused a huge explosion, creating a gap.

The next moment, a new force field filled the gap. Just as Psionic Prime was about to continue attacking, Ames flicked her finger, and an invisible force field enveloped the Apostle Weapons that were close to her and threw them away. Then, a force field with a larger range was formed, and like Moses opening the sea, the mechanical army was split apart. The mechanical soldiers were thrown away by the force field one after another. Ames' powerful control ability was displayed to the fullest.

Her force field Esper Ability was good at controlling a large range and could counter the human wave tactic to a certain extent.

Right at this moment, a light suddenly flashed behind Ames. Mad Sky Hunter teleported and appeared behind Ames. He opened his mouth, revealing his high-frequency vibrating alloy teeth, and bit toward her waist.

His upper and lower jaws clenched together, but he missed.

A long, white finger tapped on the head of Mad Sky Hunter's mechanical beast, and Ames flipped over. The Void Bloodline pattern appeared on her face. She directly used Void Hyperdrive to avoid the sneak attack. Ever since she was strengthened by the Evolution Cube, her mobility had increased by more than a little.

A turbulent force field followed her finger and blasted into Mad Sky Hunter's body.

Force Field Finger Shockwave!

Cracks appeared on Mad Sky Hunter's body, and a large number of parts were crushed. His mechanical body was heavily damaged, and he was so frightened that he hurriedly jumped away from Ames.

The range of the force field Esper Ability was very wide, but the closer it was to the main body, the stronger the force field would be.

Suddenly, Ames felt the fluctuation of the Void Dimension. She looked up and saw that Han Xiao, who was slapped on Floating Dragon, had disappeared. He had used Void Hyperdrive to escape from the attack range.

Han Xiao shook his slightly numb arm, looked at the combat information, and was speechless.

"She actually dealt me overwhelming damage. Only a Pugilist like Heber would be able to crush Floating Dragon with his head."

However, although the damage was high, Han Xiao did not care about it at all. No matter how strong Ames' AOE was, there was a limit to it.

His current health recovery rate was extremely high. As long as the enemy's instantaneous explosive power did not reach a certain level or did not have special attack effects such as [Heavy Injury], his main body was not afraid.

Floating Dragon, which missed, did not continue to smash toward the gas giant planet. Instead, it made a turn and smashed toward Han Xiao. Its huge body slashed across the planet, and the gas on the surface of the planet showed obvious signs of being stirred, forming a huge storm. Looking down at the planet, it looked like a vortex.

In the distance, Ames used Dragon's Gaze again. Han Xiao felt another force field enveloping him, but he had already received the combat information and was not prepared to fall for it this time. He clapped his hands together.

Hum!

The mechanical suit trembled, and it continuously released repulsive force, creating a 'field' within a few meters. The outer shell was filled with repulsive force, and the inner part was filled with chaotic repulsive force.

This' field 'bounced away most of Ames' force fields, and the few that broke through the outer shell were deflected by the internal chaos. Dragon's Gaze was almost ineffective.

This was the 'Anti-Dragon Throne Device' that Han Xiao had specially built. The principle was to stack repulsive force rings to form a repulsive shield field, which was used to neutralize external force fields and greatly reduce the effect of the force fields on the user.

However, it was a mechanical device after all, and there was a limit to its performance. Ames' force fields could be stacked continuously, and she would be able to break through the repulsive shield field if given enough time. Therefore, Han Xiao did not plan to get close to Ames. Instead, he wandered from afar and played a game of hide-and-seek with Floating Dragon while controlling the Mech Legion to attack.

Seeing that Han Xiao did not approach, Ames began to move, dealing with the Mech Legion while flying toward Han Xiao.

Seeing this, Han Xiao also retreated, maintaining a distance. After getting rid of the control skill of the force field, Floating Dragon could not catch up to him at all. Its mobility was obviously greater than Ames', and it firmly held the initiative.

Seeing that one Floating Dragon could not do anything to Han Xiao, Ames' hand formed a claw and made a grabbing motion toward a Satellite Grade Brick that was charging toward the Mech Legion formation.

This Satellite Grade Brick suddenly stopped, as though it was fixed in place. Then, layers of force fields began to compress, and the increasing pressure caused the Satellite Grade Brick to tremble. The metal was squeezed inward, and the density gradually increased.

Ames' arm slowly stretched backward, and the force field continued to compress, accumulating a huge elastic force. The next moment, her eyes shone brightly, and she clenched her fist and punched out like an arrow. The elastic force stacked on the Satellite Grade Brick instantly exploded!

This Satellite Grade Brick suddenly spun like a stone shot out by a slingshot, instantly accelerating far beyond the speed of a cannonball and shooting toward Han Xiao!

Force Field: Satellite Grade Cannon!

The terrifying acceleration directly peeled off a layer of metal shell, almost causing this man-made satellite to disintegrate.

Han Xiao's eyes flashed, but he did not dodge the satellite brick at all, ignoring it completely.

At the same time, Silver Flash, who was far away, instantly transformed into the main body of the Star Destroyer Cannon and fired in the direction of the satellite!

The thick bright silver beam accurately hit this Satellite Grade Brick, and the silver beam directly pierced through it like a table knife piercing through a meatball!

The next moment, this metal satellite expanded from the inside out, and a dazzling red light burst out, exploding in front of Han Xiao like an orange!

The metal that made up the satellite was instantly melted by the high temperature of the Star Destroyer Cannon, and all the fragments turned into red molten metal streams like splashing orange juice.

A huge man-made satellite was blown up in front of his eyes, and Han Xiao casually dodged the splashing hot melted metal.

This was like a signal, and more Satellite Grade Bricks also reached the limit of their durability and were blown up by the concentrated fire of the Mech Legion. Three more Satellite Grade Bricks were quickly destroyed.

There were only six Satellite Grade Bricks left under Ames' control, and they were also heavily damaged, as if they would disintegrate at any moment.

Looking at this scene from afar, Han Xiao had a calm expression as he muttered to himself,

"What are you going to do next?"

Ames' attacks were fierce, but they did not cause much damage to Han Xiao at all. The mechanical soldiers that had been strengthened many times were extremely tough, and they were no longer substandard products that could be easily crushed by Force Fields. Although it seemed like Ames had the initiative, in reality, Han Xiao had been controlling the rhythm of the battle with ease the entire time.

Ames also felt this and narrowed her eyes.

"My attacks were useless against him, and they were all nullified by him …"

She could see that Han Xiao was mainly defending and did not have any desire to attack. He was obviously going easy on her.

But even so, she could not do anything to Han Xiao!

"Has he already grown to this stage …"

Ames narrowed her eyes and finally experienced firsthand how strong Han Xiao was. The difference in strength was already very obvious, and Black Star was much stronger than her.

However, her emotions did not fluctuate too much. The battle was not over yet, and she would not give up halfway.

Ames suddenly grabbed toward the gas giant, and a large group of meteorites turned into her weapon under the guidance of her Force Field. Like meteors, her fists smashed toward the Mech Legion.

Force Field: Dragon Breath Meteor Punch!

This planetary ring was her huge arsenal!

"No wonder you purposely chose this place as the battlefield." Han Xiao nodded in his mind.

The meteorites in the planetary ring continued to become Ames' weapons, smashing toward the Mech Legion time and time again. The Mech Legion also shattered the incoming meteorites time and time again. Under the leadership of Han Xiao, the battle inevitably entered a battle of attrition.

…

Just as the two of them were fighting around the desolate planet, a fleet was parked far away from the battlefield. It was Floating Dragon's armed fleet.

Because their base had been used by their boss, these fleets could not continue to stay on Floating Dragon and could only carry everyone to watch the battle.

Although the price of property in Floating Dragon was very low due to the risk factors, there would still be people who would buy property. Seeing their property being used to fight, the eyelids of many of the crew members twitched. Every time Floating Dragon clashed, their emotions would fluctuate greatly.

In the main ship, a group of Floating Dragon officers were watching the battle. Seeing that their leader was gradually being forced into a passive position, their expressions were not good.

Black Star was indeed their ally, but as members of Floating Dragon, they naturally hoped that Ames would win.

Other than the officers, there were also two remote projections present. They were Hella and Aurora, both of whom were staring at the battlefield without blinking.

There was no need to keep the private battle a secret. Ames had informed Hella and Aurora. As Ames' students, the two of them had the right to know.

"Teacher is no match for Black Star." Aurora had a conflicted expression.

Hella had a complicated expression as she nodded.

The identities of the two sisters were a little awkward. They were Black Star's officers and Dragon Emperor's students. Both sides were close to each other, so they did not know who to support.

Hella had studied with Ames for ten years and was very clear about how strong Ames was. Her heart was filled with respect for her. Seeing her beloved teacher being suppressed by Black Star, she had a complicated feeling.

The aftermath of the battle between Beyond Grade As also made her understand that this was not a battle she could participate in. It was still too early for her current level. Even with Hella's strong personality, she could not help but have some self-doubt.

Beyond Grade As are too scary. Planets are just their toys. Can I really have such a strong ability?

…

Countless meteorite fragments and metal parts floated on the battlefield. The tug-of-war between the two of them lasted for a very long time.

Controlling the force field for a long time had drained a large amount of Ames' energy and stamina. Her forehead was covered in sweat, and her condition was obviously declining. The strength of her force field and the range of her ability were gradually decreasing.

On the other hand, Han Xiao was still as lively as ever. He had (Efficient Energy Absorption), so the efficiency of his mana recovery was not something Ames could compare to.

He did not lack mana, so he kept using (Advanced Machinery Construction) and (Waste Modification) to revive the mechanical soldiers that died. The army's losses were minimal.

As Ames' condition declined, his control of the battlefield became more and more obvious. Ames' defensive force field was already broken through by the Apostle Weapons. She had to deal with the many Apostle Weapons and could not even take care of herself. She no longer had the energy to attack Han Xiao.

Psionic Prime stabbed his spear toward Ames' abdomen. Ames twisted her waist and dodged the attack head-on. Psionic Prime's spear brushed past her defensive force field.

Another Apostle Weapon, Gold Prime, attacked from the side, but its fist was blocked by the force field.

Ames raised her leg and lashed out like a whip. The leg strength strengthened by the force field instantly created a huge hole in Gold Prime's abdomen armor. She then slapped Gold Prime away, and its parts flew everywhere.

Suddenly, another Apostle Weapon shot out a psionic cannon, shattering the force field behind her back and hitting her body. Ames immediately frowned and felt pain.

Seeing this, Han Xiao, who was watching the battle from afar, had a gleam in his eyes.

"It's about time. She doesn't have much energy left."

At this time, Ames suddenly looked up at Han Xiao, who was slacking far away. She pulled with both hands and released a powerful suction force with her body as the center, pulling all the Apostle Weapons and mechanical soldiers toward her.

Caught off guard, the mechanical soldiers were squeezed into a pile.

At this time, Han Xiao's senses suddenly moved, and he sensed the fluctuation of the Void Dimension.

Without hesitation, Han Xiao turned around and raised his arm. The whip kick wrapped in a powerful force field was blocked by his arm. It was Ames, who had jumped behind him.

"You actually dare to get close to me … Are you putting all your eggs in one basket?"

Han Xiao's eyes flashed, and he grabbed Ames' calf and pulled her toward himself. His other hand formed a fist and punched toward Ames' abdomen.

Bang!

In a hurry, Ames blocked the heavy blow with the force field on her abdomen. At the same time, she raised her palm, and the compressed force field turned into a sharp invisible blade, slashing toward Han Xiao's neck.

However, her palm was only halfway through when Han Xiao grabbed Ames's leg with one hand and her neck with the other. The thrusters on his back were operating at full power, and he grabbed her and slammed her into a meteorite.

This meteorite was directly smashed into pieces, but Han Xiao did not stop. He grabbed her and rushed into the meteorite cluster, crushing one meteorite after another with her body.

The two of them turned into streams of light and circled around the planet, smashing countless meteorites. Han Xiao only felt that Ames' protective force field was getting weaker and weaker, almost disappearing.

Han Xiao slowed down and slammed into another meteorite. This time, it did not shatter. Instead, he pressed Ames into the meteorite and made the two of them stop.

The mechanical suit ejected a ring of oxygen and enveloped the two of them. Han Xiao put away his helmet, revealed his head, and shook it.

"You're almost out of energy. You lost."

At this time, Ames was frowning, enduring the pain. There were many scratches on her black dress, revealing her fair skin. Her slender neck was roughly held in Han Xiao's hand, and one of her legs was clamped by Han Xiao's arm. She could not break free even if she wanted to.

Hearing this, Ames forced a smile. "No … I still have the energy for one last attack."

Han Xiao narrowed his eyes and said calmly, "Okay, let me see what else you have."

Under his gaze, Ames slowly raised her arm, bent her finger … and gently flicked Han Xiao's forehead.

There was no force.

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows, and he was a little surprised.

Ames retracted her hand and dispersed the force field that was almost disappearing. Her tense body relaxed, and she pursed her lips into a smile.

"Okay, I've used up my last bit of energy. You win."

Han Xiao let go of Ames's neck and touched his forehead helplessly.

"Naughty."
